core_coverage.answer_quote: Amumu's basic attacks apply Curse to enemies.
Cursed enemies take bonus true damage when they receive magic damage.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the damage trigger and bonus damage type without restricting the magic damage's source.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Amumu throws a bandage that deals magic damage and stuns the first enemy hit, pulling him to them.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the thrown projectile, first-enemy collision, damage and stun.
Explicitly identifies Amumu as moving to the enemy hit.

core_coverage.answer_quote: He stores up to two charges that replenish over time.
core_coverage.reason: Explains both the supported maximum and replenishment.

issues: Counterplay says to keep 'other enemy units' between the reader and Amumu. From the reader's perspective, those units can be Amumu's allies, which the supplied first-enemy-hit mechanic does not establish as blockers. Repair the allegiance wording to specify units that are enemies of Amumu.
The answer itself is supported; the unsupported blocker advice causes the card-level factual-support failure.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Amumu toggles an aura that continually deals magic damage to nearby enemies, including damage based on their maximum health.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the toggle, nearby repeated magic damage and maximum-health component.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Its damage refreshes existing Curse marks.
core_coverage.reason: Explicitly limits refresh to existing marks.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Tantrum passively reduces incoming physical damage.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the passive reduction and correct damage type.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Activating it deals magic damage to surrounding enemies.
Basic attacks that hit Amumu reduce its remaining cooldown.
core_coverage.reason: States the supported general trigger and remaining-cooldown effect without claiming that only successful damaging hits qualify.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Amumu deals magic damage to surrounding enemies and stuns them.
core_coverage.reason: Explains damage and stun in the area surrounding Amumu.

core_coverage.answer_quote: He also applies Curse to affected enemies.
core_coverage.reason: Explicitly explains Curse application without claiming it amplifies that same hit.

conflicts.resolution: Use Wiki's basic-attack trigger to qualify Riot's broad wording. The draft does so. Keep blocked attacks, blindness misses and repeated on-hit interactions in metadata; they do not require removing the general mechanic.
conflicts.topic: Riot describes E cooldown reduction whenever Amumu is hit; Wiki specifies basic attacks and detailed hit interactions.

factual_risks: Q counterplay has an allegiance ambiguity that can teach incorrect projectile blocking.
The tank-stat build focus is inferred teaching guidance, not an evidence-established optimal build.
Supplied evidence is version-pinned; current-client behavior and visuals were not verified.
No visible passive cue is established by the supplied evidence.
Supported advanced exceptions can remain in metadata: the answers do not assert universal shield bypass, complete damage negation or immediate amplification of R's own damage.
UNAPPROVED and provenance notes occur in metadata, not in the supplied card-facing answers or counterplay. This check does not constitute human approval.
